text: 🏛️ Keep Our Towns Strong End Tallahassee's preemption of local land management, governance, and autonomy. Our communities know what's best for our communities.
🏠 Make Florida Affordable Again End profiteering, price gouging, and scams. Get insurance rates under control so Florida families can afford to live and stay here.
🛡️ End Terror in Our Communities Get ICE out of our communities. Support disciplined, professional policing that protects everyone—regardless of where they were born.
